title: Phase 4: §22.6 system-one-core smoke test (release-gating)
objective: Add the acceptance-catalog criterion for spec §22.6 and maintain the cross-repository smoke test that points system-one-core's HTTP provider to a running fake-jev instance. §22.6 already requires this test to pass before a public v1 release, so the item is release-gating by specification, not by invention.
acceptance: a maintained smoke test points system-one-core's HTTP provider at a running fake-jev instance per §22.6
release gating recorded per §22.6: not required in every pull request, must pass before a public v1 release
verification stays deterministic: no model call and no external provider network access
nonGoals: no changes to the system-one-core repository itself
no unconditional per-PR gating (§22.6: not required in every PR)
nextAction: pick up in phase 4: pin the criterion wording, then define the smoke-test mechanics
notes: This item is the sole holder of docs/development/acceptance-catalog.md in allowedFiles; no other work item may edit the catalog.
If release wiring is needed, it rides FJ-042's release workflow — coordinate an allowedFiles amendment at pickup rather than editing .github/workflows here.
